purpose: Test whether a native HUGSIM dynamic object's rendered camera membership and image support correspond to source-side dynamic support on two reader-declared held-out factual timestamps. This is a sensor-information pilot, not an AD or real-sensor equivalence test.

availability_gate.reason: Local scene-0041 and scene-0138 archives contain reconstruction checkpoints and metadata but no source RGB. The official 2.38 GB sample-data ZIP contains source observations only for scene-0383.
availability_gate.selected_alternative: source-side dynamic masks and RGB for scene-0383, which are upstream of and independent from the HUGSIM renderer but share metadata and preprocessing provenance with reconstruction

selection_basis: all six camera records at each timestamp satisfy the released dataset-reader test rule idx modulo 30 >= 24
source metadata projects the native dynamic center into CAM_FRONT_LEFT at frame 44
source metadata projects the native dynamic across CAM_FRONT_LEFT and CAM_BACK_LEFT at frame 49, providing a multi-camera boundary case
selection.selection_independence: The exact frame-44 and frame-49 source RGB, source masks and HUGSIM renders were not inspected before freezing this record. Selection used only source metadata geometry and the released reader split rule.

reference_provenance.source_dynamic_mask_definition: stored mask false pixels are the intersection of source semantic vehicle-class pixels and the source-metadata projected native dynamic box
reference_provenance.independence: the mask is computed from real source imagery by upstream semantic preprocessing and source geometry, not from HUGSIM rendered RGB
reference_provenance.shared_dependency: the source geometry and mask were inputs to reconstruction; the mask is therefore a partial external reference, not independent real-world ground truth
reference_provenance.held_out_boundary: reader-declared test membership is checked; checkpoint split provenance remains incomplete, so this is not claimed as a fully independent unseen benchmark

render_control.factual: source-init pose with the released native dynamic checkpoint
render_control.static_control: the identical source-init pose, intrinsics, scene checkpoint and renderer with only the frame dynamics dictionary omitted
render_control.isolated_construct: pixel support caused by the native dynamic render path

continuous_primary: fraction of factual-minus-static RGB difference energy inside the exact source dynamic mask
fraction of difference energy inside a 16-pixel dilation of the source dynamic mask
difference-energy weighted centroid error to the source-mask centroid
camera membership of nonempty source mask and nontrivial rendered dynamic support

threshold_sensitivity.pixel_delta: mean absolute factual-minus-static RGB difference in 8-bit intensity units
threshold_sensitivity.interpretation: No single threshold is a pass boundary; the family checks conclusion sensitivity.

measurements.negative_control: cameras with an empty source dynamic mask should be reported separately rather than pooled as successful overlap

decision_rules: A zero source mask makes that camera unsupported by this reference, not a HUGSIM failure.
Zero rendered difference energy in every source-supported camera rejects the minimal native-dynamic observation path.
Nonzero overlap qualifies only bounded source-to-render camera/support retention.
No numerical overlap value will be promoted to a real-sensor equivalence threshold.
Source mask, semantic preprocessing, source geometry and HUGSIM output must not be treated as mutually independent votes.
strongest_allowed_claim: For the selected source timestamps, HUGSIM's native dynamic render path does or does not preserve source-side camera membership and overlapping image support under the declared partial-reference construction.
claims_to_reject: The source dynamic mask is real-world ground truth.
Overlap proves photometric, semantic, depth or sensor equivalence.
Overlap proves that SparseDrive or another AD receives sufficient task information.
Two timestamps establish general HUGSIM credibility or AD safety.
